convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorX2MA indicator which is a custom indicator requiring the .ex5 compiled file, making it non-reproducible with built-in MT5 indicators alone. The EA logic itself is straightforward but the custom indicator dependency requires manual recreation of the indicator logic.

other_exits: Position is closed on opposite signal (signal reversal) - the ColorX2MA color change from bullish to bearish closes longs and vice versa

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM>0 uses risk-based fraction of deposit, MM<0 uses fixed lots equal to absolute value of MM

custom_logic_notes: ColorX2MA is a double-smoothed moving average that changes color based on trend direction. The EA reads the color state (trend direction) from the custom indicator's buffer, not from crossover calculations. Signal is generated on new bar when the ColorX2MA color/trend state changes. The indicator uses two MAs internally and the color reflects their relationship, but this logic is encapsulated in the custom indicator. Digit adjustment is applied: SL/TP values are multiplied by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: The ColorX2MA custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. It is likely a double moving average (X2 = MA of MA or similar smoothing) with color-change signaling. Need to identify the exact MA types and periods used inside ColorX2MA to replicate. The EA shell is simple (new bar check, single position, signal-reversal exit), so once the indicator is replicated, Python conversion is straightforward. Pay attention to digit adjustment for SL/TP pip values on 5-digit brokers.
